summary: Full-stack testing of ShoulderReady RTS Analytics. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth register/login/me/logout/role, session (invalid path), profiles CRUD + owner isolation + cascade delete, assessments (perfect green zone, weighting formula verification, weak zone/weak links, LSI when healthy=0, list+filter, get+delete, AI roadmap generation with 3 exercises & retest_weeks). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844): login → create athlete (name/age/sport/surgery chips/weeks) → athlete detail → start assessment → 5-block wizard (intro + Psych sliders + ROM/Strength/Functional steppers + apprehension toggle + sport sliders) → results dashboard (RTS 85 yellow, circular gauge, 5-axis radar [Психология/Мобильность/Сила/Стабильность/Мощность], component bars, AI-generated summary, disclaimer) → History tab shows athlete/score/date. Google OAuth session endpoint verified rejects invalid session_id with 401.

issues: Minor React warning: `transform-origin` should be `transformOrigin` (React 19 DOM naming). Non-blocking.
Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated'. RN-Web deprecation notices; non-blocking but recommend migration.

Custom font (IBMPlexSans) fails to decode on web preview — served as HTML by unstable_path; the app falls back to system fonts. Consider serving fonts with correct MIME or bundling. Non-blocking for functionality.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Fix `transform-origin` -> `transformOrigin` in gauge/radar SVG for cleaner console.
(Optional) Replace deprecated RN style props: shadow* -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents.
(Optional) Fix font MIME-type / bundling so IBMPlexSans renders on web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: Scoring engine, LSI formula, RTS weighting (15/15/25/25/20) and zone thresholds (>=90 green, >=75 yellow, <75 red) all verified via pytest against expected math.
Auth protection is correctly enforced on /profiles and /assessments (401 without/with invalid Bearer token). Owner isolation confirmed (other user gets 404).
MongoDB _id is properly excluded across all responses.
AI roadmap fallback path present when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing; live LLM successfully returned ai_generated=true with 3 exercises in backend test.
seed_data_creation: Created a UI test athlete 'TEST_UI_Athlete' under demo_coach@example.com and one completed assessment (RTS 85, yellow). Multiple TEST_ profiles were created and cleaned up by pytest, plus a couple of random test users (test_*@example.com).
